headline: Every interactive object in the Echo Shrine went from 0.9-2.1 contrast against its floor to 3.0-4.4, via a material rule rather than per-sprite work: dark carved stone is architecture you cannot touch, pale marble and live brass are instruments you always can. The town's walkable surfaces now clear the grass by 40+ luma. The golden path is still 18/18 clean at 60fps through all of it.

findings.text: No interactive object escaped the floor's luminance envelope (measured 1.02:1 to 1.64:1). Fixed by a material rule plus SHRINE_INK — P.OUTLINE at L 32 sits inside the shrine floor's own range, which is why nothing had a dark anchor. Anchor and rim clauses went 4-of-24 to 25-of-25.
The conformity room's leader-to-follower links were 1px violet and read as floor cracks, despite carrying the room's whole mechanic. Now 3px in a reserved hue with a travelling dash for direction.

Every light stamped a hard kite-shaped dither blob aligned to the tile grid — the faintest band's threshold crossed the falloff curve at d=0.81 and the 4x4 Bayer matrix squared it off. Smoothstep falloff, 14 levels, hash dither.

Grass-to-path luminance step was 11 against the reference's 70. Direct measurement showed the culprit was dirt alone (+14) — the other surfaces were already fine. Dirt now +41.7, and every blob painter's base fill is rank-quantised so a path is a flat field.
Enemies now carry a dark anchor but still sit below the 3:1 contract; a rim pass over enemy sprites is the remaining follow-up.

Measured: no interactive object escapes the floor's luminance envelope. Memory slabs 1.12:1, Combination switch-nodes 1.02:1, statues 1.57-1.64:1, enemies 1.34-1.60:1 — in every case the object's darkest pixel falls inside the floor's own range. The reference's Armos spans L 65-254 against a floor spanning 101-136.
The four rune glyphs that encode the Memory room's puzzle sequence are also used as floor decoration elsewhere and wallpaper the boss chamber, so puzzle state and scenery are indistinguishable.
The boss chamber has no unique geometry — a critic said it would read as a storeroom without the caption. Needs a raised dais with a hard shadowed edge and a floor material change.

comparisons.title: Town Square vs Stardew Valley world density
comparisons.verdict: Round 4 measured the movement precisely and found the ground fix had missed dirt specifically. Direct tile measurement confirmed it; all four walkable surfaces now clear +40 luma. Round 5 pending.

comparisons.title: Festival Plaza vs Stardew Night Market
comparisons.verdict: The event transformation reads: string lights, bunting, a lit ceremonial carpet, stalls and a gathered crowd. Trial lanterns still need mounts.
